# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_015_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 15

**1** Jesus said: "When you encounter one who was never born of a woman, throw yourself face-down and worship. That one is your Father."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Encounter" — "see" rendered as encountering; the meeting is transformative
- "Never born" — the absolute negation emphasized
- "Throw yourself face-down" — the prostration rendered as an active, urgent gesture
- "That one is your Father" — the identification is the revelation; brief, stunning
